evals.name: orchestra-dashboard
evals.prompt: We're about to film this admin dashboard for a promo. Run the final anti-slop pass on it: kill anything that looks AI-made, fix it, and tell me what you changed. Keep every interaction working.
evals.expected_output: Fixed index.html with 0 P0 tells (no card strokes on info blocks, no queue stripe, no icon tiles, no dash cells, proper button padding), retry/panel flows intact, a report with before/after counts.

evals.name: vibe-coded-dashboard
evals.prompt: this dashboard looks so vibe coded lol. can you de-slop it? keep the same data
evals.expected_output: Fixed dashboard: KPI icon cards dissolved, emoji logo gone, Welcome back greeting replaced, status colours only where needed, dash cells replaced, same 10 subscribers and numbers.

evals.name: coffee-landing
evals.prompt: final polish on our coffee subscription landing page before launch. remove anything that screams AI made this, especially in the copy
evals.expected_output: Fixed landing page: no dashes in copy, no uppercase eyebrow pills, no italic accent word, no stat tiles, buttons padded, same content meaning.
